allowed.line: This repository holds the independent verifier for the Open Control Stack. It reads the records a run leaves behind and checks them without using any of the stack's own code: its own JSON parser, its own canonical form, standard library only. It reports whether the record is internally consistent and which parts it could not check; detection rates are measured by the qualification repository and are not reported here (the report's `mutation_report` member is always null). It is a verification report, not an attestation or certification. It cannot show that a decision was right, that a destination really did or did not act, or who produced the record. Pre-release; nothing here is published.
